summary: Kolibri Global Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, reporting the results of its annual general meeting held May 4, 2026. Shareholders voted to fix the board at five directors, elected five nominees (Wolf Regener, David Neuhauser, Glen Brown, Lee Canaan, Murray Grigg), appointed BDO USA, P.C. as auditor, and approved unallocated entitlements under the Stock Option Plan. All resolutions passed with strong support. This is a routine AGM outcome with no event-driven special-situation elements, so no further analysis is warranted.
